viewContainer.title: Kanban Summary
view.board.name: Summary
command.open.title: Open Kanban Board
command.addFeature.title: Add Card
command.openDirectory.title: Open as Kanban Board
config.title: Kanban Sauce
config.fontSizeColumnHeader.description: Font size for column headers in the Kanban board (e.g. '16px', '1.1rem').
config.fontSizeCardTitle.description: Font size for card titles in the Kanban board (e.g. '14px', '1rem').
config.fontSizeCardDescription.descripti: Font size for the card body/description text in the Kanban board (e.g. '14px', '0.9rem').
config.fontSizeCardLabel.description: Font size for custom label tags on cards in the Kanban board (e.g. '12px', '0.8rem').
config.fontSizeCardMeta.description: Font size for card metadata like assignee, due date, epic, filename, and badges (e.g. '13px', '0.8rem').
config.fontSizeEditorHeader.description: Font size for headings in the markdown editor/preview panel (e.g. '18px', '1.5rem').
config.fontSizeEditorBody.description: Font size for body text, lists, and tables in the markdown editor/preview panel (e.g. '16px', '1.1rem').
config.fontSizeEditorMeta.description: Font size for elements in the metadata block above the editor/preview panel (e.g. '14px', '0.9rem').
config.filenamePattern.description: Pattern used to generate filenames for new cards. Changing this setting will offer to rename all existing card files to match.
config.filenamePattern.nameDatetime: Name then date and time — e.g. my-card-2026-02-23-143045
config.filenamePattern.datetimeName: Date and time then name — e.g. 2026-02-23-143045-my-card
config.defaultStatus.inProgress: In Progress - currently being worked on
config.columns.id.description: Unique identifier for the column (used in frontmatter status)
config.columns.color.description: Color for the column header (hex format)
config.showLabels.description: Show labels on cards and in editors.
config.showEpic.description: Show epic (parent grouping) on cards and in editors.
config.showFileName.description: Show the source markdown filename on cards.
config.compactMode.description: Use compact card layout to show more cards.
config.addNewCardsToTop.description: When enabled, new cards are added to the top of the column instead of the bottom.
config.markdownEditorMode.description: Open card files in VS Code's native text editor instead of the inline rich-text editor.
config.hideScrollbar.description: Hide scrollbars in the Kanban board (scrolling still works).
config.language.description: Language for the Kanban Sauce UI. Set to 'auto' to follow VS Code's display language.
